purpose: Auditable transfer from a rights-cleared original concept through img2threejs intake into the shipped procedural creature implementation

img2threejsRuns.result: 1024x1024 RGB PNG; object isolated on a neutral authored plate
nine 3x3 inspection crops generated from the original plate
separate albedo, roughness, normal, height and AO study maps
img2threejsRuns.implementationPolicy: Below the 0.70 texture-import threshold. Maps are study evidence only; no generated map is loaded by public/ or dist/. Palette, matte response and frequency separation were transferred parametrically.

runtimeTransfer.finding: A single pelvis-to-muzzle silhouette must carry the body mass; no sphere-stack torso
runtimeTransfer.implementation: src/creatures/speciesMeshes.ts:179-201 uses a continuous 15-ring createDepthLoftGeometry core

runtimeTransfer.finding: Legs require embedded shoulder/hip roots and tapered paws rather than detached capsules
runtimeTransfer.implementation: src/creatures/speciesMeshes.ts uses addEmbeddedLoftLeg for all four Emberpup legs

runtimeTransfer.finding: Ear and tail roots must overlap sockets while preserving negative space
runtimeTransfer.implementation: src/creatures/speciesMeshes.ts uses tapered curved appendages with embedded roots

runtimeTransfer.finding: Warm matte fur needs independent meso normal and roughness response, not metallic plastic
runtimeTransfer.implementation: src/render/materials.ts creates deterministic fur normal/roughness maps; metalness remains zero and roughness is tuned matte

runtimeTransfer.finding: Gameplay-distance facial life requires anterior-lateral eyes, irises and catchlights
runtimeTransfer.implementation: src/creatures/speciesMeshes.ts:225-239 exposes layered eyes above the muzzle

scaffoldStatus.assessment.json: intake scaffold; not a completed visual assessment
scaffoldStatus.detail-inventory.json: generated zone skeleton; not a completed semantic inventory
scaffoldStatus.sculpt-spec.json: blockout scaffold; does not pass img2threejs --strict-quality
scaffoldStatus.claim: These scaffolds are retained as reproducible intake evidence, not represented as validated production specs. The transferred runtime implementation and numeric mesh QA are the production artifacts.
